headline_item.title_zh: 美团第三季度营收增长21.6%至1156亿元
headline_item.title_en: Meituan reports Q3 revenue up 21.6% YoY to ~$17.3B, above est., and an adjusted net profit of ~$285.1M, up from a ~$2.4B adjusted net loss (Ben Jiang/South China Morning Post)
headline_item.author: South China Morning Post
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 美团发布第三季度财报，营收同比增21.6%至1156亿元，经调整净利润达19亿元，展现了价格战缓解后的盈利修复能力
headline_item.event_summary_en: Meituan reported total revenue of 115.6 billion yuan for Q3, up 21.6% YoY, exceeding analyst estimates, with an adjusted net profit of 1.9 billion yuan, marking two consecutive quarters of profitability. CEO Wang Xing and CFO Chen Shaohui attributed this performance to enhanced operational efficiency and a more rational competitive landscape, shifting strategic focus toward long-term value in the instant retail ecosystem.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美团创始人兼首席执行官王兴、首席财务官陈少晖在第三季度财报发布会：实现营收1156亿元及经调整净利润19亿元，明确未来投资生态与技术以提升长期价值
【起因与机理】行业价格战趋于理性，公司从扩张性补贴转向效率驱动的增长模式
【关键数据与实测】美团发布截至9月30日的第三季度财报，季度总营收达1156亿元人民币，同比增长21.6%，超出市场平均预期；经调整净利润为19亿元，实现连续两个季度盈利。
【各方立场与态度】战略转向即时零售生态深耕，挑战在于与互联网巨头的长期存量博弈。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Wang Xing (CEO), Chen Shaohui (CFO) (Q3 Earnings Call): Achieved 115.6B yuan revenue and 1.9B yuan adjusted net profit; pivot to ecosystem and tech efficiency
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Rationalization of market competition and reduction of unsustainable subsidies

[Key Metrics] Meituan reported total revenue of 115.6 billion yuan for Q3, up 21.6% YoY, exceeding analyst estimates, with an adjusted net profit of 1.9 billion yuan, marking two consecutive quarters of profitability.
[Key Position & Outlook] Strategic focus on instant retail ecosystem amidst persistent competition from internet giants.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 美团盈利模式的扭转表明中国即时零售行业已从流量驱动的非理性价格战步入存量效率竞优阶段。随着主要竞对竞争强度减弱，美团通过压降获客成本和精细化运营改善利润率，但长期增长仍受制于本地生活服务边界扩张过程中与互联网巨头在新零售场景下的深度摩擦。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: Meituan's turnaround signals a transition in China's instant retail sector from subsidy-fueled growth to efficiency-driven competition. While the easing of price wars has bolstered margins, the company's long-term sustainability hinges on its ability to defend market share against platform incumbents within the broader instant-retail vertical.

headlines.title_en: Hackers breach US Air Force flagship Cloud One computing platform
headlines.author: Mike Stone and Raphael Satter
headlines.event_summary_zh: 路透华盛顿11月27日 - 三名知情人士告诉路透社，黑客已经攻破了美国空军的旗舰云计算平台，此举可能会危及大量敏感的战术、人员和后勤数据。 Cloud One 的入侵是在内部发现的
headlines.event_summary_en:
WASHINGTON, Nov 27 (Reuters) - Hackers have breached the US Air Force's flagship cloud computing platform, three people familiar with the matter told Reuters, in a development that could jeopardize a vast swathe of sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics data.

headlines.title_zh: 我们的 2027 年 35 岁以下创新者竞赛现已开放

headlines.author: Amy Nordrum
headlines.event_summary_zh: 每年，《麻省理工科技评论》的编辑都会选出 35 名世界顶尖的年轻科学家、企业家和发明家，作为我们最新一届 35 岁以下创新者。从今天开始，我们的 2027 年竞赛正式开放提名。我们正在寻找工程研究人员和创始人
headlines.event_summary_en:
Every year, the editors at MIT Technology Review select 35 of the world’s top young scientists, entrepreneurs, and inventors to honor as our newest class of Innovators Under 35. And starting today, our 2027 competition is officially open for nominations.

We’re on the hunt for researchers and founders who are engineering solutions to some of the most formidable problems society faces, including human disease and climate change. We also recognize those who have made clever and useful inventions,

celebrity.author: Sam Altman
celebrity.quote_zh:
文是最早相信我们可以使用当时的模型来解决千禧年奖金问题的人之一。

世界上有很多才华横溢的人，但才华横溢，并且拥有正确的信心和勇气，继续推动别人认为不可能的事情，是一件非常有价值的事情，而且相当罕见。

我很感激 OpenAI 的很多人都拥有这种组合。
celebrity.quote_en:
Ven was one of the earliest believers that we could use our then-current model to solve millenium prize problems.

There are a lot of brilliant people in the world, but being brilliant and also having correctly-placed confidence and courage to keep pushing on something that others don't think is possible is a very valuable thing and fairly rare.

I am grateful so many people at OpenAI have this combination.
